summary: Implemented and verified the DeepSeek-V4.1 C2 boundary-state wire contract: C4 compressor pending state is now a distinct row-granular component, odd committed boundaries transfer exactly one FP32 (kv, score) row using endpoint-local request slots and ring capacities, and even boundaries transfer no C2 payload. Mooncake and NIXL enforce exact index cardinality and incompatible legacy layouts remain distinguishable by state type. The broader end-to-end PD + DSpark feature remains only partially qualified because the prepared MI350X/ROCm node cannot run the CUDA/NPU-only DSpark implementation and no DeepSeek-V4.1 target/draft weights or multi-worker transport topology were supplied.

tests.what_was_measured: 93 tests plus 17 subtests covering shared PD wire behavior, unequal-ring C2 index mapping, row-granular registration and payload size, NIXL metadata/transfer helpers, and Mooncake transfer batching. Final raw output: reports/j-180e7a7f59ec/raw/final-unit-tests.log
39 tests plus 12 subtests after adding the explicit 12 KiB three-layer C2 registration regression. Raw output: reports/j-180e7a7f59ec/raw/wire-regression.log

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-180e7a7f59ec/venv/bin/python < inline C2 row-copy numerical check
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X, copied the N=101 pending row from a request-local ring of 2 into a different request slot with ring 8 for source layers 2, 8 and 14. Each row was 4096 bytes, total logical payload 12288 bytes, all 1024 FP32 values matched an independent CPU arange reference exactly, and an adjacent destination row remained NaN. Raw output: reports/j-180e7a7f59ec/raw/gpu-c2-row-copy.log
Python syntax/import compilation for the changed runtime modules.

remaining_limitations: End-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark generation was not run: DSpark rejects ROCm and requires CUDA or NPU, while the assigned GPU is an AMD Instinct MI350X.
No DeepSeek-V4.1 target and DSpark draft weights were provided locally; the deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify this architecture or DSpark semantics.
Mooncake and NIXL were covered at the protocol/unit layer, not with a real multi-process or cross-node RDMA generation workload.

Streaming, concurrency, chunked prefill, prefix hits, partial/full rejection, cancellation, slot reuse, acceptance rate, throughput, and generation parity against a colocated DeepSeek-V4.1 reference remain unverified end to end.

Decode radix cache and dynamic/ragged DSpark verification remain unsupported by the existing guarded static candidate; multimodal rebootstrap and heterogeneous parallel layouts also remain outside the supported configuration.
No native source was changed, so no native rebuild was applicable. The pinned Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and ROCm 7.2 stack was preserved.
